It connects you directly with Allah, five times a day
Every prophet before us prayed — it is the greatest act of worship

levels.title: Wudu: The First Half
levels.goal: Learn the first steps of wudu — hands to face

tips: Wudu is required before every salah
Say بِسْمِ اللّٰه before you begin
Wash each part with clean water, right side first

lessons.title: Hands, Mouth, Nose, Face
lessons.description: The first four steps of wudu

steps.title: Wash your hands
steps.detail: Three times, up to the wrists, between the fingers

steps.title: Rinse your mouth
steps.detail: Three times — swish the water and spit it out

steps.title: Clean your nose
steps.detail: Sniff water in gently, then blow out — three times

steps.title: Wash your face
steps.detail: Three times, hairline to chin, ear to ear
steps.dua_translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

data.hadith: When a Muslim performs wudu properly, his sins fall away from his body, even from under his fingernails.

lessons.title: Starting With His Name
lessons.description: The words that open your wudu

data.context: Say this as you begin washing

questions.question: What do you say before starting wudu?
How many times do you wash your face?

levels.title: Wudu: The Second Half
levels.goal: Complete wudu — arms to feet, and the closing dua

lessons.title: Arms, Head, Ears, Feet
lessons.description: The final four steps of wudu

steps.title: Wash your arms
steps.detail: Right then left, three times, up to and including the elbows

steps.title: Wipe your head
steps.detail: Once, with wet hands, from front to back

steps.title: Wipe your ears
steps.detail: Once — inside with your index fingers, outside with your thumbs

steps.title: Wash your feet
steps.detail: Right then left, three times, up to and including the ankles

lessons.title: The Closing Testimony
lessons.description: Look up and say this after wudu

data.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
data.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and messenger
data.context: Say this after finishing wudu, looking up

lessons.title: Order Matters
lessons.description: Keeping wudu in the right sequence

tips: Always wash in order: hands, mouth, nose, face, arms, head, ears, feet
Doing wudu in the correct order is part of the Sunnah
Take your time — there's no rush in worship

levels.goal: Know what invalidates wudu and how to prepare to pray

tips: Face the Qibla — the direction of the Ka'bah in Makkah
Make sure your body, clothes, and place of prayer are clean
Cover yourself properly before you begin
